# Learn 3D with Cheetah 3D v4.0.0

The Missing Manual for Cheetah 3D — modeling, materials, lighting, rendering and animation.

- Docs: https://learn3d.loewald.com
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/Learn-3D-with-Cheetah-3D
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/learn-3d-with-cheetah-3d

## Documentation

Full documentation, with live code examples, is at the links below.

Pages below are also available as plain markdown: append `index.md` to the URL
(for example `/4.1_A_Quick_Tour_of_Cheetah_3D/index.md`).
Prefer that if you only need the text. A page marked noindex has no markdown copy.
